sections.description:
A new patch is now live on PC. Read below to learn more about the latest changes.

To share your feedback, please post in the General Discussion forum For a list of known issues, visit our Bug Report forum. For troubleshooting assistance, visit our Technical Support forum.

blocks.title: General
blocks.body: - Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash

blocks.title: Heroes
blocks.body: - Fixed a bug that caused Pharah’s neck to distort in her Medal victory pose

blocks.title: Mystery Heroes
blocks.body: - Fixed a bug that prevented Eichenwalde or Hollywood from appearing in the Mystery Heroes map rotation

blocks.title: UI
blocks.body: - Fixed a bug that caused players to become immobile after their UI lost focus when entering a match
